title: Typst helper optional arguments and paragraph leading were invoked with invalid call shapes
symptom: The first compile rejected a positional value for a named optional helper parameter; the next compile rejected `leading` on `text()`.
expected_behavior: The source should use Typst's actual function signatures and compile without authoring API errors.
actual_behavior: Compile stopped before PDF production in two successive authoring attempts.
proposed_fix: Use the helper's named argument (`s:`) and keep line leading in paragraph-level styling rather than passing an unsupported `leading` argument to `text()`.
fix_attempt: Rewrote only the invalid call sites in source.typ and reran the original Typst compile/validation path.
verification: The revised source compiled successfully to an eight-page PDF and passed qpdf plus Poppler consumption.
